Tom Morello's 'Power To The People' Festival To Be Livestreamed For Free

Oct 1st, 2026 - 10:58am by wookubus
0

This weekend’s ‘Power To The People‘ festival will be livestreamed across the internet via MS NOW (formerly MSNBC)/YouTube. That event will begin broadcasting this Saturday, October 03rd. See the below embed for the respective start time in your time zone. Billed as ‘a non-partisan celebration of peace, justice, solidarity, music, and community action,’ the festival was overseen by Rage Against The Machine guitarist Tom Morello. It will be held at the Merriweather Post Pavilion in Columbia, MD.

Though not exclusively, it also sports a lineup peppered with artists known to be outspoken about their political beliefs. Bruce Springsteen will appear as a special guest, with the following artists also booked:

Foo Fighters
Dave Matthews
Tom Morello
Joan Baez
Public Enemy
Jack Sabbath
Dropkick Murphys
Cypress Hill
Nathaniel Rateliff
Killer Mike
Serj Tankian (System Of A Down)
Stephen Stills
Mike McCready (Pearl Jam)
Brittany Howard (Alabama Shakes)
Taylor Momsen (The Pretty Reckless)
Geezer Butler (Black Sabbath)
The Linda Lindas
Darryl “DMC” McDaniels (RUN-D.M.C.)
Matt Cameron (Soundgarden, ex-Pearl Jam)
State Radio
Scott Ian (Anthrax)
grandson
The Last Internationale
The Neighborhood Kids
Shephard Fairey (DJ set)

Jack Sabbath is made up of actor/musician Jack Black and a collective of young musicians that includes Tom‘s son Roman Morello, Scott Ian‘s son Revel (also of XCOMM), Yoyoka Soma, and Hugo Weiss.
